state.work_item: Form new en-suite shower room in bedroom connecting to existing soil stack
state.jurisdiction: England. The Building Regulations 2010 as amended.

clauses.text: 12. Installation of a sanitary convenience, sink, washbasin, bidet, fixed bath, shower or bathroom in a dwelling, that does not involve work on shared or underground drainage. | A person registered in respect of that type of work by Association of Plumbing and Heating Contractors (Certification) Limited, ... Building Engineering Services Competence Assessment Limited, Certsure LLP, HETAS Limited or NAPIT Registration Limited, ....

Foul water drainage: H1.—(1) An adequate system of drainage shall be provided to carry foul water from appliances within the building to one of the following, listed in order of priority—(a) a public sewer; or where that is not reasonably practicable,(b) a private sewer communicating with a public sewer; or where that is not reasonably practicable,(c) either a septic tank which has an appropriate form of secondary treatment or another wastewater treatment system; or, where that is not reasonably practicable,(d) a cesspool. (2) In this Part “foul water” means waste water which comprises or includes—(a) waste from a sanitary convenience, bidet or appliance used for washing receptacles for foul waste; or(b) water which has been used for food preparation, cooking or washing. | Requirement H1 does not apply to the diversion of water which has been used for personal washing or for the washing of clothes, linen or other articles to collection systems for reuse.

route.instructions: Under the Building Regulations 2010 in England, which notification route applies to this work item if it is carried out on its own in the building described?

criteria.not_notifiable: No Building Regulations notice needed: not building work (reg 3), only Schedule 4 work, or an exempt building (reg 9, Schedule 2).
criteria.competent_person_scheme: Notifiable work listed in Schedule 3: a registered competent person can self-certify it (reg 12(6)(a)); otherwise a building notice is needed.
criteria.building_notice_or_full_plans: Building work not covered by Schedules 3 or 4: a building notice or a full plans application to building control (reg 12(2)).
criteria.full_plans_required: Building work that must have a full plans application: the Fire Safety Order applies to the building (reg 12(3)), it fronts a private street (12(4)), or H4 applies (building over or near a sewer, 12(5)).
